title: mono: validateApp requires owner (libs/shared-contracts) + apps pass team as owner, single PR
README bucket names: out of scope (lee said separate); not done

summary: validateApp (libs/shared-contracts in mono) now throws if owner is missing; core-shell/billing/reports pass their package.json team (platform/payments/insights) as owner. Single PR #1 merged, CI+CD green. Assumptions: the lib is in-repo and inlined at build, so no version bump or registry publish was needed and platform-kit is untouched; hardcoded owner strings match each package.json team. The README fake-bucket-names request was explicitly 'separate' so I left it undone.
